title: PageLedger Contested Spans
description: contested/<page_id>.json in a document job: where a reader's text (the base) differs from a literal engine's reading of the same page. Rebuilt from the retained readings by verify-job. Schema version 0.1.

rules.description: The versioned rule set that settled spans, such as ru-print-0.1.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text that span offsets index.

adapter.description: The literal engine; glyph pairs are listed per engine.

kind.description: homoglyph and glyph are settled by rule; misprint_guard is a literal non-word the engine's known confusions do not explain, possibly a printed misprint, and is never settled by rule.

start.description: Offset in the base text, in code points.

base.description: The base text between start and end; empty where only the witness has words.

witness.description: What the literal engine read here; empty where only the base has words.

text.description: The text a settled span keeps.
